rows.harness: extern "C" void run();int seq[100],count;extern "C" void made(int n){if(n==99)throw n;}extern "C" void used(){if(99==99)throw 99;}extern "C" void destroyed(int n){seq[count++]=n;}int main(){bool caught=false;try{run();}catch(int n){caught=n==99;}int expected[]={4,3,2,1};if(caught!=true||count!=4)return 1;for(int i=0;i<count;++i)if(seq[i]!=expected[i])return 2;return 0;}

rows.name: local_static_atexit
rows.source: namespace std{template<class T>class initializer_list{const T*p;unsigned long n;public:constexpr initializer_list():p(0),n(0){}constexpr const T*begin()const{return p;}constexpr const T*end()const{return p+n;}constexpr unsigned long size()const{return n;}};}extern "C" void made(int);extern "C" void destroyed(int);extern "C" void used();struct S{int n;S(int n):n(n){made(n);}S(const S&s):n(s.n){made(n);}~S(){destroyed(n);}};extern "C" void run(){static std::initializer_list<S>x{1,2};}

#include <cstdlib>
extern "C" void run();int count,seq;extern "C" void made(int){++count;}extern "C" void destroyed(int n){--count;seq=seq*10+n;}void verify(){if(count||seq!=21)std::_Exit(3);}int main(){std::atexit(verify);run();run();return count!=2;}
